title: Property (japan_ski_property)
description: A Japanese ski-area property tracked as a potential acquisition. Specialises the core asset: core fields live in the asset record, this schema defines the domain_attributes payload. Carries the full attribute set required by the master prompt section 20, including the history fields that make a delisted property useful as a comparable.

size_original_units.description: Japanese listings often quote tsubo. The original figure and unit are retained; conversion is a recorded transformation.

construction_type.description: Bears directly on renovation cost, insulation potential, snow-load capacity and financing.

pre_1981_seismic_standard.description: Buildings predating the 1981 seismic code revision carry materially different risk and upgrade cost. Verify from the construction date rather than assuming.

practical_guest_capacity.description: Guests the property could realistically sleep to a commercial standard — not the listing's optimistic figure, and constrained by bathrooms and common space, not just beds.

onsen_rights.description: Hot-spring rights materially affect both nightly rate and operating cost, and do not always transfer with the land.

licence_status.description: Never assume a residential property can lawfully be operated as commercial accommodation. An existing transferable licence is one of the strongest value signals in this domain.

condition_assessment_basis.description: listing_photos is the weakest basis. A condition judged from photographs must never drive a firm renovation figure.

hazard_notes.description: Avalanche, flood, landslide or volcanic exposure noted from hazard maps.

agent_contacted.description: Always false unless the owner has explicitly approved contact. The engine never contacts agents autonomously.

data_gaps.description: Attributes not yet established. Listed explicitly so that an incomplete record is never mistaken for a complete one.
